prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The novelist is **Peter Carey**. He won the Booker Prize twice—for *Oscar and Lucinda* (1988) and *True History of the Kelly Gang* (2001)—and received the Jerusalem Prize in 2012.
